(Founder and Managing Director) Sanjeev Jain
(Founder & Managing Director) Arushi Jain
(Director) | products = {{hlist|[[Pharmaceutical]]s| [[Nutraceutical]]s| [[Ayurvedic]]s| [[API]]s| [[Cosmetics|Cosmetic]]s | [[Dermatology]]s| [[Skincare]]s }} | revenue = {{Increase}} {{INRConvert|1538.75|c|lk=on}} (FY24) | assets = {{Increase}} {{INRConvert|2095.43|c|lk=on}} (FY24) | num_employees = 10,000+ (2024) | subsidiaries = *Akumentis Healthcare Limited. *Pure And Cure Healthcare Private Limited. | website = {{URL|https://www.akums.in/}} }} '''Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited (Akums Group)''' is an Indian pharmaceutical [[Contract manufacturing organization|Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization]] (CDMO) that serves both domestic and multinational pharmaceutical companies.{{Cite web |last=Mishra |first=Mihir |date=2023-04-30 |title=Akums Drugs plans IPO within 3 years |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/akums-drugs-plans-ipo-in-2-3-years-to-give-exit-to-quadria-capital-expand-globally-and-double-net-sales-to-inr-10-000-crore-by-2028-11682877664726.html |access-date= |website=mint |language=en}}{{Cite news |title=Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd. - Analyst Research Report |url=https://www.sbisecurities.in/fileserver/research/reports/Akums%20Drugs%20and%20Pharmaceuticals%20Limited_IPO%20Note.pdf |work=SBIsecurities}} The company was established in 2004 and became publicly listed on 6 August 2024.{{Cite web |last=Kumar Nahar |first=Pawan |date=2024-08-06 |title=Akums Drugs & Pharma shares list at 7% premium on BSE, NSE |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/company-stock/story/akums-drugs-pharma-shares-list-at-7-premium-on-bse-nse-440279-2024-08-06 |access-date= |website=Business Today |language=en}} == History == Akums was founded by Sanjeev Jain and Sandeep Jain in 2004, who currently serve as the managing directors of the company.{{Cite web |title=Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited - Analyst Research Report |url=https://www.hdfcsec.com/hsl.docs/Akums%20Drugs%20and%20Pharmaceuticals%20Limited%20IPO%20Note-202407301109282134935.pdf |website=HDFCsec}} The company has 12 manufacturing facilities for various formulations and two facilities for producing [[Active ingredient|active pharmaceutical ingredients]] (APIs).{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2023-12-05 |title=Akums buys new facility in Baddi to augment tablet output |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/akums-buys-new-facility-in-baddi-to-augment-tablet-output/article67606924.ece |access-date= |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} It produces tablets, capsules, soft gels, dry syrups, liquid orals, and other pharmaceutical products.{{Cite web |date=2023-09-23 |title=Quadria Capital-backed Akums, India's largest contract manufacturer of drugs, kicks off 2024 IPO plans |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/quadria-capital-backed-akums-indias-largest-contract-manufacturer-of-drugs-kicks-off-2024-ipo-plans-11415811.html |access-date= |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} Akums also operates four research and development (R&D) centers in India.{{Cite news |last=Somvanshi |first=Kiran |date=2024-07-30 |title=Akums Pharma placed at a vantage point in pharma growth |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/akums-pharma-placed-at-a-vantage-point-in-pharma-growth/articleshow/112122401.cms?from=mdr |access-date= |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} In 2020, the company received an investment of Rs 500 crore from [[Quadria Capital]]. In April 2022, the company acquired a manufacturing facility from Ankur Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited.{{Cite web |last= |title=Akums acquires drug manufacturing facility from Ankur Drugs - ET HealthWorld {{!}} Pharma |url=https://health.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/pharma/akums-acquires-drug-manufacturing-facility-from-ankur-drugs/90844833 |access-date= |website=ETHealthworld.com {{!}} Pharma |language=en}} In May, the company received a license to manufacture and commercialize [[Bempedoic acid]], a drug used to [[Lipid-lowering agent|lower cholesterol]]. Two of the company's units in Haridwar were granted European GMP certification. One unit produces solid oral dosage forms, such as tablets and hard gelatin capsules, while the other manufactures large and small volume parenterals, including vials, ampoules, eye drops, and FFS formulations.{{Cite web |last= |title=Akums receives EU GMP approval for two manufacturing units in Haridwar - ET HealthWorld |url=https://health.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/industry/akums-receives-eu-gmp-approval-for-two-manufacturing-units-in-haridwar/92702622 |access-date= |website=ETHealthworld.com |language=en}} In August 2024, the company went public with a listing on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]]. In May 2025, Akums received a patent for an extended-release combination formulation of [[Doxylamine]] and [[Pyridoxine-dependent epilepsy|Pyridoxine]], indicated for the management of nausea and vomiting in pregnancy.{{Cite web |last=Singh |first=Anjali |date=May 5, 2025 |title=Akums secures patent for dual-action nausea drug for pregnant women |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/akums-secures-patent-for-dual-action-pregnancy-nausea-treatment-125050501037_1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260224082025/https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/akums-secures-patent-for-dual-action-pregnancy-nausea-treatment-125050501037_1.html |archive-date=2026-02-24 |access-date=2026-03-29 |website=www.business-standard.com |language=en-US}} In July and September 2025, Akums received [[Good manufacturing practice]] (GMP) certifications for its manufacturing facilities in Haridwar, including from [[Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency]] and the [[Eurasian Economic Union]] (EAEU) for its hormonal therapy unit.{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2025-07-28 |title=Akums secures Anvisa GMP certification for Haridwar plant to boost Brazil, LatAm exports |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/akums-receives-anvisa-gmp-certification-for-haridwar-sterile-manufacturing-facility/article69865758.ece |access-date=2026-04-22 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}}{{Cite web |last= |title=Akums’ hormonal drug plant receives Eurasian Union nod |url=https://pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/pharma-industry/akums-receives-eaeu-gmp-certification-for-hormonal-drug-manufacturing/123782708 |access-date=2026-04-22 |website=ETPharma.com |language=en}} In January 2026, two of its facilities in Haridwar, Uttarakhand, received European Union GMP certification issued by the Bulgarian Drug Agency (BDA).{{Cite web |last= |title=Akums secures EU GMP certificate for two manufacturing units |url=https://pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/regulatory-update/akums-secures-eu-gmp-certificate-for-two-manufacturing-units/127283745 |access-date=2026-04-22 |website=ETPharma.com |language=en}} In November 2025, a 20-year patent for Dual Release Gastro-Resistant Composition effective from 19 November 2022, was granted to the company under the [[Patent Act of 1790|Patents Act, 1970]].{{Cite web |title=Akums Drugs gets 20- year patent for |url=https://www.indianpharmapost.com/news/akums-drugs-gets-20-year-patent-for-dual-release-gastro-resistant-composition-18144 |access-date=2026-04-22 |website=indianpharmapost}} In February 2026, it received approval from the United Kingdom’s [[Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency]] (MHRA) to market rivaroxaban, an anticoagulant, in the country.{{Cite web |last= |title=Akums secures blood thinner Rivaroxaban marketing approval in UK |url=https://pharma.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/drug-approvals-and-launches/akums-secures-blood-thinner-rivaroxaban-marketing-approval-in-uk/128255271 |access-date=2026-04-22 extract: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited (Akums Group) is an Indian pharmaceutical Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that serves both domestic and multinational pharmaceutical companies. The company was established in 2004 and became publicly listed on 6 August 2024.
